title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
description: Research conditions in local, regional, national, or online markets. Gather information to determine potential sales of a product or service, or plan a marketing or advertising campaign. May gather information on competitors, prices, sales, and methods of marketing and distribution. May employ search marketing tactics, analyze web metrics, and develop recommendations to increase search engine ranking and visibility to target markets.

tasks.text: Prepare reports of findings, illustrating data graphically and translating complex findings into written text.
Collect and analyze data on customer demographics, preferences, needs, and buying habits to identify potential markets and factors affecting product demand.
Conduct research on consumer opinions and marketing strategies, collaborating with marketing professionals, statisticians, pollsters, and other professionals.
Measure and assess customer and employee satisfaction.
Devise and evaluate methods and procedures for collecting data, such as surveys, opinion polls, or questionnaires, or arrange to obtain existing data.
Measure the effectiveness of marketing, advertising, and communications programs and strategies.
Seek and provide information to help companies determine their position in the marketplace.
Forecast and track marketing and sales trends, analyzing collected data.
Gather data on competitors and analyze their prices, sales, and method of marketing and distribution.
Monitor industry statistics and follow trends in trade literature.
Attend staff conferences to provide management with information and proposals concerning the promotion, distribution, design, and pricing of company products or services.
Develop and implement procedures for identifying advertising needs.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Writing
skills.def: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.def: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

skills.name: Mathematics
skills.def: Using mathematics to solve problems.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.def: Persuading others to change their minds or behavior.

skills.name: Systems Analysis
skills.def: Determining how a system should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes.

skills.name: Systems Evaluation
skills.def: Identifying measures or indicators of system performance and the actions needed to improve or correct performance, relative to the goals of the system.

skills.name: Learning Strategies
skills.def: Selecting and using training/instructional methods and procedures appropriate for the situation when learning or teaching new things.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Operations Analysis
skills.def: Analyzing needs and product requirements to create a design.

skills.name: Instructing
skills.def: Teaching others how to do something.

skills.name: Graphics or photo imaging software
skills.def: Software to draw or manipulate images. May adjust colors, add text, or apply special effects. Examples: Adobe Creative Cloud software, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, Canva.

skills.name: Video creation and editing software
skills.def: Software to enable production of video content. Examples: Adobe After Effects, Apple Final Cut Pro, Loom, TikTok.

skills.name: Customer relationship management CRM software
skills.def: Software to manage customer interactions. Examples: Act!, Blackbaud The Raiser's Edge, Galilee Enterprise TargetPro, Insightful Corporation Confirmit.

skills.name: Data mining software
skills.def: Software to access or automatically extract information from a data source. Examples: Cytel Software XLMiner, Google Analytics, IBM Intelligent Miner, NCR Teradata Warehouse Miner.

skills.name: Presentation software
skills.def: Software to create presentations, speeches, or slideshows. Examples: Apple Keynote, Google Slides, Microsoft PowerPoint.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: IBM Notes, Microsoft Outlook.
